family_reports.body: This system has destroyed my family when all I was asking for was help. It has cost me my mental health, my children’s sense of security, and feeling a loss so big that it hurts us all. It has hurt innocent children and left them with unanswered questions and where their “mom” is.

The family court system deprived me of my life, liberty and the persuit of happiness. I never thought I would experience grieving the loss of my children while knowing they're still alive and being abused on a daily basis without being able to heal and live a normal childhood. Going from tucking them in at a night to crying myself to sleep, I am forced to muster up the strength to keep going and I feel as if I'm fighting for my life every single day, this has truly been the most excruciatingly painful thing I could ever imagine, and I would not wish this upon anyone.
This system has caused irreparable damage to my children and I. Their lives have been negatively impacted due to the inability of the system to function properly!
